groups.summary: Modified ExceptionInfoFormatter to truncate recursive tracebacks when the recursion origin cannot be located, showing only the first and last 10 frames by default, with an option to show full tracebacks.
groups.title: Truncate undetectable recursive tracebacks for better performance and readability

groups.summary: Added changelog entries documenting the memoization of line numbers per traceback and the truncation of undetectable recursive tracebacks to inform users about the performance and usability improvements.
groups.title: Add changelog entries for improvements

groups.summary: The pyproject.toml lint.ignore list was updated to remove several ignored rules, effectively enabling them to enforce stricter linting. This helps catch more code issues and improve code quality.
groups.title: Enable additional ruff linting rules

groups.summary: Small code changes were made to improve code clarity and correctness, including simplifying tuple construction, removing deprecated logging level, and adding noqa comments to suppress new lint warnings.
groups.title: Minor code cleanups and formatting adjustments

groups.summary: Changed the internal storage of FixtureDefs from a simple mapping to a nested mapping keyed by node, improving fixture lookup performance and fixing a regression causing quadratic slowdown. This is the core change affecting fixture management.
groups.title: Refactor fixture storage data structure

groups.summary: Added tests to verify fallback behavior and error messages when fixtures are looked up using deprecated string nodeid keys, ensuring backward compatibility during the deprecation period.
groups.title: Add tests for deprecated nodeid-based fixture handling

groups.summary: Added a changelog entry describing the regression fix and updated tox.ini to comment out a test broken by the fixture storage refactor, maintaining accurate project metadata and test configuration.
groups.title: Update changelog and configuration

groups.summary: Corrects how pytest.approx treats Decimal values outside float range, preventing incorrect infinite treatment and fixing max difference calculations to avoid errors with decimal.FloatOperation traps. Also restores proper tolerance display for Decimal values.
groups.title: Fix decimal.Decimal comparison handling in approx

groups.summary: Fixes AttributeError when comparing numpy arrays with object dtype (e.g., arrays of Decimal) and improves handling of numpy scalar unboxing in approx comparisons.
groups.title: Improve numpy.ndarray handling in approx for object dtype

groups.summary: Introduces PytestApproxDecimalToleranceWarning emitted when float tolerances are used with Decimal comparisons, to alert users about widened tolerances due to float imprecision.
groups.title: Add warning for float tolerance usage with Decimal in approx

groups.summary: Refactor the help text wrapping logic to keep explicit line breaks, indentation, and list item formatting intact. This change ensures that help texts are more readable and structured, especially for lists and paragraphs.
groups.title: Preserve indentation and blank lines in help text wrapping

groups.summary: Modify the ini option help display to use the new wrapping function, preserving indentation and blank lines in the output. This improves the clarity of ini option help messages in the CLI.
groups.title: Update help display to use improved wrapping logic

groups.summary: Add new tests for both command-line option help and ini option help to ensure that indentation, blank lines, and list formatting are preserved as expected. Also add unit tests for the new wrapping function to verify its behavior.
groups.title: Add tests verifying preservation of indentation and blank lines in help texts

groups.summary: Add a changelog entry describing the fix that preserves indentation and blank lines in help texts, explaining the previous issue and the improvement.
groups.title: Add changelog entry for help text formatting improvement

groups.summary: Modified core config and logging code to accept native integer and boolean types for various ini options when specified in TOML files, while maintaining backward compatibility with string values. groups.summary: Updated the reference documentation to specify that several configuration options now accept native integer and boolean types in TOML files, including examples and type annotations.

groups.title: Add changelog entry for native TOML type support

groups.title: Add tests for native TOML type support and invalid values

groups.summary: The expired server's certificate signing request, private key, and certificate were updated, likely to reflect the new CA constraints and maintain consistency with the updated CA.

groups.title: Regenerate MTLS client certificates and keys

groups.summary: The valid server's certificate signing request, private key, and certificate were updated to be consistent with the updated CA constraints, maintaining test accuracy.
groups.title: Regenerate valid server certificates and keys

The request handler is simplified to route all HTTP methods to the WSGI application, improving maintainability.
groups.title: Enable HTTP/1.1 with chunked transfer and keep-alive in development server

groups.summary: The debug middleware now uses the Response class to generate error pages and static resources, adding proper content types, ETags, and support for HTTP caching. This improves compliance with HTTP standards and reduces duplicated code.
groups.title: Refactor DebuggedApplication error response and static resource handling

groups.summary: The PR deletes the Ubuntu font file and its license, and modifies the CSS to remove references to the Ubuntu font and replace them with generic sans-serif fonts. This reduces dependencies and licensing concerns for the debugger UI.
groups.title: Remove embedded Ubuntu font and update CSS to use system fonts

groups.summary: The PR changes the Response constructor to use 'mimetype' instead of 'content_type' for consistency and fixes a malformed DOCTYPE declaration in the debugger's HTML template. These changes improve correctness and consistency in the debugger's error page rendering.
groups.title: Fix response content type and HTML syntax in debugger

groups.summary: Changed the default status code for append_slash_redirect from 301 to 308 to preserve the request method and body during redirects. This aligns with modern HTTP standards and previous routing changes.
groups.title: Update default redirect status code to 308

groups.summary: Modified Response to disable autocorrect_location_header by default, so relative Location headers remain relative and do not include scheme and domain unless explicitly enabled. This affects how redirects are sent to clients.
groups.title: Disable automatic Location header correction by default

groups.summary: Refactored the test client to properly handle following redirects and avoid errors when not following them. Updated tests to reflect the new default redirect status code and Location header behavior, including enabling autocorrect_location_header in some tests to verify absolute URLs.
groups.title: Fix test client redirect following logic and update tests

groups.summary: Added filterwarnings setting to setup.cfg to treat warnings as errors during tests, improving test robustness.
groups.title: Add pytest warning filter to treat warnings as errors

groups.summary: Modified the WSGIRequestHandler to not set Transfer-Encoding: chunked for 1xx, 204, 304 responses and HEAD requests, aligning with HTTP specifications and preventing incorrect chunked encoding for responses that must not have a body.
groups.title: Fix Transfer-Encoding header logic in development server

groups.summary: Renamed loop variable in _add_subclass_info to avoid shadowing and improve clarity, with no behavior change.
groups.title: Refactor debug repr type checking loop variable

groups.summary: Added an entry to CHANGES.rst documenting the fix to the development server's Transfer-Encoding header behavior for certain HTTP responses.
groups.title: Update changelog for Transfer-Encoding fix

groups.summary: Modified the StateMachineMatcher to allow rules that do not enforce strict slashes to match paths with trailing slashes, ensuring that routes like '/path' match '/path/' when strict slashes are disabled.
groups.title: Fix route matching for rules without strict slashes

groups.summary: Re-exported ValidationError from converters in the routing module to maintain backward compatibility and updated the changelog to document this restoration.
groups.title: Restore ValidationError import and update routing exports

groups.summary: Added test cases to verify that rules without strict slashes correctly match paths with trailing slashes, ensuring the new matching logic works as intended.
groups.title: Add tests for matching behavior with trailing slashes

groups.title: Add build, provenance, and publish GitHub Actions workflow

groups.title: Update existing GitHub Actions workflows for improved reliability and permissions

groups.title: Add and move flake8 configuration to a dedicated file

groups.title: Update core code for Python 3.12 compatibility

groups.summary: Adjusted tests to align with changes in behavior or warnings under Python 3.12, including fixing assertion placement and removing redundant assertions.
groups.title: Update tests for Python 3.12 compatibility

groups.summary: Updated changelog to note Python 3.12 compatibility and modified pyproject.toml to adjust warning filters to reflect changes in Python 3.12 beta.
groups.title: Update project metadata and warnings for Python 3.12

groups.summary: The mypy version is updated from 1.10.0 to 1.11.1 in both dev and typing requirements to leverage improvements and fixes in the newer version.
groups.title: Update mypy version in requirements

groups.summary: Minor changes in type annotations and addition of type ignore comments are made in source files to ensure compatibility with the updated mypy version and to suppress false positives.
groups.title: Adjust type annotations and ignore comments for mypy compatibility

groups.summary: The tox.ini commands for pip-compile are updated to use a quieter and more explicit syntax, improving clarity and potentially reducing noise during builds.
groups.title: Refine tox commands for dependency compilation

groups.summary: The core change replaces pytest-xprocess with ephemeral_port_reserve for port management and introduces a new DevServerClient class to manage live dev server processes and requests, supporting TCP, Unix sockets, and SSL contexts.
groups.title: Replace pytest-xprocess with custom ephemeral port reservation and dev server management

groups.summary: Test files are updated to remove pytest-xprocess usage and related warnings, and to use the new DevServerClient interface with type annotations and improved test structure.
groups.title: Update test code to use new dev server client and remove pytest-xprocess warnings

groups.summary: The dependency files are updated to remove pytest-xprocess and psutil, and add ephemeral-port-reserve, reflecting the new approach to managing ephemeral ports and server processes.
groups.title: Remove pytest-xprocess from dependency files and add ephemeral-port-reserve

groups.summary: The GitHub Actions workflows for pre-commit, publish, and tests now use 'astral-sh/setup-uv' to set up Python environments with caching enabled, and run commands via 'uv' to ensure consistent dependency resolution and environment reproducibility. groups.title: Replace Python setup and dependency management with 'uv' in CI workflows

groups.title: Update pre-commit configuration to include uv lock hook

groups.summary: The ReadTheDocs configuration is updated to use Ubuntu 24.04 and Python 3.13, and installs 'uv' via asdf to run the Sphinx build command through 'uv' for consistent environment management.
groups.title: Update .readthedocs.yaml to use Ubuntu 24.04 and 'uv' for docs build

groups.summary: Several source files have minor formatting fixes such as line breaks, assertion formatting, and adding noqa comments to imports to suppress linter warnings. These changes improve code readability and maintainability without changing behavior.
groups.title: Minor code style and formatting cleanups

groups.summary: Test files are updated to fix broken repr formatting and add TODO comments for unresolved resource warnings in multipart tests, improving test output clarity and maintainability.
groups.title: Fix test warnings and update test code

groups.summary: The .gitignore file is simplified by removing redundant entries for virtual environments and pytest cache directories, keeping it concise and focused.
groups.title: Clean up .gitignore to remove redundant entries

groups.summary: Replaced manual tempfile creation and atexit cleanup with context managers for temporary files in generate_adhoc_ssl_context to improve resource cleanup and code clarity.
groups.title: Refactor SSL context temporary file handling

groups.title: Refine string handling in Werkzeug serving and file storage modules
